chunks: And Isḥāq ibn Jarīr narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
He used to say: “Accompany one by whom you are adorned, and do not accompany one who is adorned by you.”

key_terms.بِكَ: Through you; by means of association with you
key_terms.تَتَزَيَّنُ: You are adorned or ennobled; your state is improved
key_terms.تَصْحَبْ: You accompany or keep company with
key_terms.يَتَزَيَّنُ: He becomes adorned or seeks enhancement

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teach about choosing companions?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches discernment in companionship, urging a person to keep company with those whose character and presence elevate him. It discourages companionship with those who merely seek social or moral advantage through association without offering genuine benefit.
